SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER ) AS BUYER_NAME /* 고객사명 */ , A.BUYER AS BUYER /* 고객사코드 */ , A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO /* 주문번호 */ , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ /* 주문항번 */ , A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO /* 관리번호 */ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO /* 품목코드 */ , A.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY /* 입고수량 */ , A.PR_NO AS PR_NO /* PR번호 */ , A.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ /* PR순번 */ , A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY /* 요청수량(확인필요) */ , A.PO_NO AS PO_NO /* 발주번호 */ , A.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ /* 발주행번 */ , CASE WHEN A.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN D.INV_NO ELSE E.INV_NO END INV_NO /* 납품번호 */ , CASE WHEN A.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' THEN D.INV_SEQ ELSE E.INV_SEQ END INV_SEQ /* 납품순번 */ , B.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE /* 발주일 */ , A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY_PO /* 발주수량 */ , A.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE /* 납품일 */ , A.IV_QTY AS IV_QTY /* 납품수량 */ , A.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY_PRE /* 기입고수량 */ , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M034' AND CODE=A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE_NM /* 거래유형 */ , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = B.AGENT) AS AGENT_NM /* 협력사명 */ FROM ICOMPODT A /* 발주 제품정보 */ , ICOMPOHD B /* 발주 마스터정보 */ , ICOMIVDT D /* 납품송장정보 */ , WMSIVDT E /* 물류센타 TR 송장 DT */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND A.PO_NO = D.PO_NO(+) AND A.PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ(+) AND A.BUYER = E.BUYER(+) AND A.PO_NO = E.PO_NO(+) AND A.PO_SEQ = E.PO_SEQ(+) AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = DECODE(A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, #{st_legacy_po_no}) AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = NVL(#{st_legacy_po_seq},' ') AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = NVL(#{st_buyer_item_no},' ')
